description: HTML Content Secure is a certified custom visual for Microsoft Power BI that renders HTML, SVG, and Markdown from your data model directly on the report canvas. Write columns and measures in DAX to generate dynamic content such as KPI cards, rich tables, narrative text, and inline SVG, or render HTML and Markdown that is already stored in your model. This edition supports a reduced set of HTML and SVG tags and does not load external resources, in order to comply with Power BI certification requirements. If you need the widest possible access to the DOM or need to load external content, use the regular HTML Content visual, which is uncertified and has no such restrictions. Built to work the way Power BI does: As a certified visual, it works with export to PDF and PowerPoint and email subscriptions, and in tenants that only permit certified visuals. First-class integration with Power BI interactivity: tooltips (including report page tooltips), cross-filtering, cross-highlighting, drillthrough, and context menus. The report theme's palette is exposed as CSS variables, so your content follows theme and high-contrast changes without hard-coded colors. Every value from your data is sanitized before it reaches the page, so report viewers only ever see the tags and attributes this edition allows.
